title: Software Engineer 3, AI Framework Integrations
jobDescription:
Job Summary
AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience (ABX) org, we're standing up a brand new engineering team in Gurugram to make that happen, and we're looking for Software Engineers to be among its founding members.
The team owns the connective layer between MongoDB and third-party AI frameworks, platforms, and tools the integrations that let developers use MongoDB effectively with the AI stack they've already chosen. That means shipping into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech, working mostly in Python and TypeScript, and partnering with the Database Experience (DBX) org when an integration needs new driver, platform, or product capability underneath it.
This is a strong role for an engineer who wants to grow into the AI space with real ownership. You'll own well-scoped projects from design through release, work with fast-moving and sometimes unproven technologies, and get a clear view of how the ecosystem is evolving. Priorities shift as frameworks change and customer demand moves, so we're looking for engineers who are adaptable, ask good questions, and take pride in shipping. Much of your work will happen in public: sending pull requests to upstream repositories, working through external maintainer review cycles, and participating in developer communities as MongoDB.
You'll work closest with the engineers sitting next to you, pairing on hard problems, reviewing each other's code, and dividing up a broad portfolio, with senior engineers and your manager close at hand as you take on larger pieces of it.
MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day. We value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
Position expectations
  • Build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra
  • Own well-scoped projects end to end on weekly-to-quarterly timelines, taking responsibility for the scope, schedule, and quality of your own work and communicating progress and trade-offs clearly
  • Solve day-to-day technical problems with growing independence, using the team's established patterns and past practice to guide your decisions, and seeking guidance on non-standard problems
  • Contribute to exploratory work on new frameworks: help evaluate an integration's feasibility, build a first working version of the piece you own, and share what you learn with the team
  • Contribute high-quality code upstream to repositories MongoDB doesn't own, following the team's contribution practices and maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy through external maintainer review cycles
  • Work within and improve the team's engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing across framework and server versions, version compatibility checks, and release steps. Suggest improvements where you see repeated friction
  • Help keep the integrations you work on healthy: monitor for upstream breaking changes, handle upgrades, triage incoming issues, and follow through after release
  • Coordinate with adjacent teams, including DBX, when your work depends on driver, platform, or product capability, and escalate cross-team dependencies and risks early rather than working around them
  • Collaborate with product management, product design, and other partners to understand what users need from an integration and how your work connects to the team's objectives
  • Write clear documentation, give useful code reviews, share what you know with teammates, and follow through on your commitments
  • Develop specialized knowledge of the Python or TypeScript AI builder ecosystems frameworks, agent and retrieval patterns, vector search and bring interesting developments back to the team
Qualifications
  • 3+ years of experience building backend systems, libraries, or other developer-facing software, with solid proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript
  • Experience designing, writing, testing, and debugging software in a shared, long-lived code base, with an eye for the tests and documentation that make it maintainable
  • Track record of delivering scoped projects reliably and on time, with growing independence and good judgment about when to ask for help
  • Demonstrated ability to work on several projects at once and keep quality and commitments intact as priorities shift
  • Clear interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape: AI frameworks, agentic patterns, RAG and retrieval, embedding, or vector search
  • Solid verbal and written technical communication, including the ability to write things down clearly for teammates and partners you won't always overlap with in real time
  • Enjoys collaboration and being part of a close-knit team; is approachable, curious, and intellectually honest
  • Eager to learn, with a strong technical foundation and an interest in deepening it
Nice to Have
  • Open source contributions, especially any work that landed in a repository you don't own
  • Experience building AI or framework integrations, MCP servers, agent skills, or plugins for agentic applications, professionally or as side projects
  • Familiarity with the agentic AI tooling ecosystem (AI IDEs, CLIs, and assistants) and how developers integrate with it
  • Experience with CI/CD and automated testing for libraries that support multiple versions or platforms
  • Experience working with databases; familiarity with MongoDB query patterns
  • Exposure to vector search, embedding pipelines, or index management
  • Working knowledge of Java, Go, C#, or Rust
  • Experience with containerization tools (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) and with AI frameworks and libraries
  • Familiarity with Jira and related tools
Success measures
  • In the first month, you will understand the team's scope, how our integrations are structured, where the relevant repositories and pipelines live, and how we build, test, and release. You'll have landed your first code contribution and know who to ask when you're blocked
  • In three months, you will be delivering scoped work on one or more integrations with growing independence, will have landed an upstream contribution, and will be comfortable running the team's testing and release process for your own changes
  • In six months, you will own a well-defined area or project end to end, deliver against quarterly objectives with limited oversight, and have made at least one concrete improvement to the quality or efficiency of how the team works
  • In twelve months, you will be a dependable owner of a piece of the portfolio, will have delivered multiple meaningful features or integrations, will be handling upstream and customer issues in your area with confidence, and will be helping teammates get up to speed on what you know best

jobDescription:
Role overview
Role: PhD Research Publications Specialist (Contract). Location: Work From Home (Remote). Industry Focus: Pharmaceutical Industry OR Data Science Industry. Contract Type: Project-based


Role objective
Role Objective: To convert conference proceedings, presentations, and industry reports into high-quality research manuscripts and successfully publish them in Scopus-indexed journals without incurring Article Processing Charges (APCs).


Deliverables
  • Minimum 3-5 Scopus-indexed publications per contract period (6-12 months).
  • All publications must be achieved without APCs (zero-cost publishing).
  • Monthly progress reports on manuscript status, submissions, and acceptances.


Key Responsibilities
  • Research Manuscript Development: Transform conference reports, presentations, and whitepapers into publication-ready manuscripts aligned with Scopus journal standards.
  • Conduct literature reviews and ensure originality, proper citation, and adherence to IMRAD structure (Introduction, Methods, Results, and Discussion).
  • Use reference management tools (Mendeley, Zotero) and plagiarism checkers (Turnitin, iThenticate) to ensure manuscript quality.
  • Journal Selection Submission: Identify appropriate Scopus-indexed journals in pharma or data science that offer free publication (subscription-based or hybrid with no APC). Verify journal legitimacy using Scopus Source List, DOAJ, and tools like thinkchecksubmit.org to avoid predatory journals. Prepare and submit manuscripts through journal portals, including cover letters, author declarations, and supplementary data.
  • Peer Review Publication Management: Respond to reviewer comments and revise manuscripts to meet acceptance criteria. Track submission status and ensure timely publication and indexing in Scopus.
  • Maintain documentation of all submissions, acceptances, and publications for organizational records.


Qualifications
  • PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, Biotechnology, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Proven track record of publishing in Scopus-indexed journals (minimum 3-5 publications as first or corresponding author).
  • Demonstrated ability to publish without APCs by identifying subscription-based or hybrid journals with zero fees.
  • Strong understanding of journal selection, manuscript preparation, and peer review processes.


Technical Skills
  • Expertise in academic writing, editing, and formatting per journal guidelines.
  • Proficiency with reference management software (Mendeley, Zotero, EndNote).
  • Familiarity with plagiarism detection tools (Turnitin, iThenticate).
  • Experience using Scopus Journal Finder, DOAJ, SCImago, and NoAPC databases for journal identification.
  • Knowledge of hybrid publishing models and APC waiver policies for researchers from developing countries.


Industry-specific requirements
  • For Pharma Industry Role: Background in pharmaceutical research, clinical studies, drug development, or regulatory affairs. Understanding of pharma conference themes: clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory updates, market access.
  • For Data Science Industry Role: Background in machine learning, AI, big data analytics, or statistical modeling. Understanding of data science conference themes: AI applications, predictive analytics, fintech data, ESG metrics.

About the Role
We are seeking a skilled Database Administrator (DBA) professional with strong expertise in database management, data security, and governance, along with experience in enterprise data integration.
The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the performance, availability, security, and compliance of database systems, while also supporting data engineering initiatives such as data integration and pipeline development. This role plays a critical part in safeguarding enterprise data, enforcing governance standards, and enabling reliable analytics across the organization.

Key Responsibilities
    • Manage, monitor, and maintain database systems across cloud and hybrid environments, ensuring high availability, performance, and reliability.
    • Perform database performance tuning, query optimization, indexing, and capacity planning.
    • Design and implement backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies.
    • Implement and enforce data security practices, including role-based access control (RBAC), encryption (at rest and in transit), and access management.
    • Apply data masking and anonymization techniques to protect sensitive and confidential data.
    • Enforce data governance policies, standards, and compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR) across database systems.
    • Monitor, audit, and track database access, usage, and security events to ensure compliance and risk mitigation.
    • Plan and execute database migrations, upgrades, and patching activities.
    • Support ETL/ELT processes and data integration workflows across enterprise systems.
    • Handle and support ingestion of structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data, including databases, files (CSV, JSON, XML), and document-based formats (PDFs, images, audio).
    • Collaborate with data engineers and architects to design scalable and optimized data architectures and storage solutions.
    • Ensure alignment between database design, data pipelines, and business requirements.
    • Maintain documentation for database configurations, security controls, and operational procedures.


Required Qualifications
    • 5+ years of experience as a Database Administrator (DBA) with exposure to data engineering principles.
    • Strong expertise in:
    • Database performance tuning, query optimization, and indexing
    • Backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies
    • High availability and reliability of database systems
    • Hands-on experience with data security practices, including:
    • Role-based access control (RBAC)
    • Encryption (at rest and in transit)
    • User and access management
    • Experience implementing data masking or anonymization techniques for sensitive data.
    • Solid understanding of data governance principles and compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001).
    • Advanced proficiency in SQL and working knowledge of Python (or similar scripting language).
    • Experience working with relational database systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL).
    • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data integration concepts.
    • Experience handling structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data (e.g., JSON, XML, PDFs, images).

Preferred Qualifications
    • Experience with cloud-based database platforms (preferably Microsoft Azure or equivalent).
    • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate or relevant.
    • Familiarity with data protection regulations and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001) and their implementation.
    • Experience with database monitoring, auditing, and security tools.
    • Exposure to supporting data engineering or analytics teams in enterprise environments.
    • Exposure to supporting machine learning data pipelines or willingness to work on AI-driven projects
    • Basic understanding of handling large datasets such as logs, images, or streaming data is a plus

This role owns the whole technology estate at Acuity Professional network, servers, cloud, identity, laptops, business applications and the security around them. Infrastructure and cloud

The AI Safety Research & Testing Professional will play a key technical role in advancing AI safety research and evaluation capabilities. The role involves designing and conducting structured, code-based evaluations of publicly accessible AI models and AI-enabled products, and developing Python-based evaluation pipelines to support these activities.

The Professional will conduct hands-on technical testing, adversarial evaluation, failure analysis, and comparative benchmarking, while monitoring emerging AI safety and security research. The role will translate empirical findings, published frameworks, and established standards into practical guidance, readiness assessments, and recommendations for industry members and partners.

This is a hands-on, technically focused research and testing role covering model APIs, open-source evaluation frameworks, evaluation datasets, automated testing, RAG, tool use, agents, and other AI-enabled application components.


Key Responsibilities

Research & Landscape Analysis

  • Conduct structured literature reviews of AI safety and security research, including reports from AI safety institutes, evaluation labs, and research organisations.
  • Track frontier and open-weight model releases and assess their safety and security implications.
  • Monitor emerging research on evaluation, red-teaming, robustness, interpretability, alignment, AI security, RAG, and agentic systems.
  • Assess relevant evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, attack methodologies, and testing tools.
  • Contribute to the Global & Regional AI Safety Landscape briefing and internal knowledge base.

Technical Testing & Evaluation

  • Design and implement evaluation pipelines using open-source frameworks and custom Python tooling to test publicly accessible models and AI-enabled products.
  • Build and maintain test scripts, model/API integrations, structured test cases, scoring rubrics, automated grading, and reporting pipelines.
  • Test key risk areas including prompt injection, indirect injection, jailbreaks, data leakage/PII exposure, hallucination, adversarial robustness, bias/fairness, over- and under-refusal, and agent/tool-use safety.
  • Evaluate application-level risks across RAG, system prompts, tool/function calling, external APIs, memory/state, and agentic workflows.
  • Conduct structured adversarial testing and red-teaming, including multi-turn and adaptive attacks where appropriate.
  • Develop reusable attack libraries, evaluation datasets, edge cases, and regression test suites.
  • Run comparative benchmarking across open-weight and commercial models and products, combining quantitative scorecards with qualitative failure analysis.

  • Apply appropriate quantitative and statistical methods, including repeated trials, uncertainty analysis, and error analysis.
  • Assess the reliability and limitations of automated evaluation, including LLM-as-judge approaches and human-evaluation agreement where relevant.
  • Investigate, reproduce, classify, and document failures and identify likely model-, prompt-, data-, retrieval-, tool-, or application-level causes.
  • Assess severity and prioritise findings based on likelihood, exploitability, impact, and potential downstream consequences.

Automation, Regression & Mitigation Testing

  • Develop automated safety regression testing to detect behavioural changes across model versions, prompts, fine-tuning, RAG configurations, tools, and application releases.
  • Maintain evaluation pipelines and results repositories for longitudinal tracking and benchmarking.

  • Apply appropriate version control, logging, configuration management, and reproducibility practices.

Advisory, Training & Knowledge Sharing

The candidate will be responsible for building and executing digital growth strategies across three distinctly different healthcare markets, each requiring a different audience, message, acquisition strategy and conversion funnel.

  • Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and emerging consumer platforms
  • Reels and short-form video
  • Influencer/creator strategies
  • Viral and shareable content
  • SEO and AI-search visibility
  • Consumer performance marketing
  • Audience segmentation and retargeting
  • Conversion optimisation
  • Community and engagement strategies

AI-First Growth Approach
The person should actively explore and use AI tools for:
Content research Content creation Creative generation Video/Reels SEO Audience identification Campaign personalisation Lead generation Lead qualification Automated nurturing Analytics Conversion optimisation
Experience with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Canva AI, Adobe AI, HubSpot, Zoho, Apollo, SEMrush/Ahrefs, Zapier/Make or equivalent platforms would be valuable.
The candidate is not expected to know every tool. More important is the ability to continuously discover and adopt new AI tools that improve marketing productivity and business outcomes.
Key Responsibilities

  • Create separate digital marketing strategies for Enterprise B2B, Mid-Market B2B and Consumer B2C.
  • Build mCURA's brand and founder/leadership thought-leadership presence.
  • Create high-engagement content across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, websites and other relevant channels.
  • Manage Google, Meta and LinkedIn performance campaigns.
  • Build targeted landing pages and conversion funnels.
  • Use AI to rapidly create and test different messaging, creatives and audience segments.

  • Drive consumer acquisition and conversion for SecretConsultation.com.

  • Continuously conduct A/B testing across creatives, messaging, landing pages, audiences and CTAs.
  • Analyse competitors, digital trends and emerging AI marketing opportunities.
  • Present a clear weekly/monthly dashboard showing marketing contribution to business growth.

What We Are Looking For
We want a growth marketer, not simply a social-media manager.
The candidate should understand that:
Selling an enterprise hospital transformation platform to a hospital CEO is completely different from acquiring a consumer for an online consultation.
They should therefore be capable of changing the content, platform, targeting, campaign economics, lead funnel and conversion strategy depending upon the audience.
Healthcare experience is preferred, but candidates from B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, consumer internet, health-tech or other high-growth digital businesses can also be considered.
Key Performance Indicators
Performance will be measured differently across the three businesses:
Enterprise Hospitals: Target-account engagement, CXO reach, qualified enterprise enquiries, meetings generated and sales opportunities influenced.
Small/Mid-Sized Hospitals & Clinics: Qualified leads, cost per lead, demos generated, lead-to-demo conversion, customer acquisition cost and conversions.
SecretConsultation.com: Relevant reach, website traffic, registrations, cost per acquisition, consultation bookings, repeat engagement and conversion rate.
What Success Looks Like
This role will not be evaluated primarily by how many posts were published or how many followers were added.
The person should be able to demonstrate:
What audience did we reach?
How much engagement did we create?
How many relevant leads did we generate?
How many converted into meetings, opportunities or customers?
What did we learn and optimise using AI?
And what measurable business growth came from digital marketing?
The objective is to make AI-enabled digital marketing a measurable customer-acquisition and growth engine across mCURA's B2B and B2C businesses.

jobDescription:
Role Overview


We are not hiring manual testers. We are looking for an Automation Quality Engineer who builds quality in someone who writes

the app-facing automation and contributes to the code that makes our mobile products testable and reliable. If you think of QE as

engineering writing code, owning frameworks, and shipping confidence with every release this role is for you. Seniority is

not the advantage here; maturity, smartness, and the ability to communicate clearly are what set candidates apart.


Key Responsibilities


Test Automation & Engineering


- Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for our mobile apps (Android and iOS) UI, functional, integration, and regression that run reliably in CI.
- Write real code alongside the team: build test utilities, harnesses, mocks, and the small pieces of app/service code that make features testable.
- Own the automation framework for your area keep it clean, fast, and low-maintenance rather than a source of flaky failures.

Mobile Quality & Coverage

- Own end-to-end quality for the features you cover, from reading the requirement to shaping the test strategy to signing off on the release.
- Test across the mobile surface: API and backend contracts behind the app, performance and responsiveness on real devices, offline/edge conditions, and cross-device/OS compatibility.
- Investigate failures to root cause, reproduce cleanly, and file reports crisp enough to need zero follow-up questions.

Quality in the Pipeline


- Integrate automated checks into the build and release pipeline so quality gates run automatically on every commit and deploy.
- Contribute to shift-left practices catching issues during the build, not after it.
- Explore AI-assisted testing to generate, maintain, and prioritize tests, and to auto-add coverage based on the nature of changes.

Collaboration & Communication

- Partner closely with developers during the build, raising the bar on testability in design discussions and code reviews.
- Communicate defects, risks, and trade-offs clearly to developers, product, and leadership, in writing and in conversation.


Required Qualifications

- 2 to 5 years building test automation for mobile apps, or strong development skills with a genuine pull toward quality engineering.
- Comfort writing production-quality code able to read a codebase and contribute to it, not just test-only work.
- Hands-on experience with mobile test automation frameworks (e.g., Appium, Espresso/XCUITest, or Flutter integration testing our apps are built in Flutter) and API testing.
- Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and how automated tests fit into them.
- Solid fundamentals in at least one modern language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Dart, Python, or Java), version control (Git), and a working understanding of how mobile apps and their backend services interact.
- Excellent written and spoken communication clear articulation and thoughtful, well-reasoned push-back.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).

Preferred / Nice to Have

- Exposure to our stack or its neighbours: Flutter, Node.js, React, REST/MCP-based services.
- Experience with device farms or cloud device testing (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, Firebase Test Lab).
- Familiarity with performance, accessibility, or security testing on mobile.
- Interest in AI-assisted testing using AI tools to generate, maintain, or prioritize tests.

Soft Skills / Traits

- Sharp judgment and quick learning matter more than years of experience.
- Strong communication and articulation, with technical and non-technical audiences alike.
- High ownership mentality treats the quality of every release as a personal responsibility.
- Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving AI SaaS company.
- Collaborative works closely with engineering, product, and QA/DevOps teams.
